title: Hermes Memory settings plugin configuration
description: Per-plugin (global) configuration for the hermes-memory-plugin. The hermes MemoryConfig fields themselves live in the external ~/.pi/agent/hermes-memory-config.json (edited via the settings form + the plugin's own routes), NOT in this dashboard config. See change: add-hermes-memory-settings-plugin.

enabled.description: When false, the plugin is inactive (no settings section, no routes). Default-enabled when the pi-hermes-memory extension is installed.
